{{Quote|Lrashtash<br />System: Usean II. The lrashtash is an ''[sic]'' herbivore that evolved on the third world where I was stationed.|Personal notes of Wilek Nereus|<ref name="TTaBS" />}}
'''Usean II''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[rocket grass]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] and the [[Diet/Legends|herbivore]] [[lrashtash]], which had large incisor-like [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] to frighten predators. At some point, when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Wilek Nereus]] was stationed on Usean II, he added a set of lrashtash teeth to his dental [[Collector/Legends|collection]]. Later, when Nereus was asked about the origin of the teeth, he claimed they were from an "[[Useani camnzin]]," a predator he invented for his own entertainment and that of his inquirers.

==Description==
{{Quote|The lrashtash, however, is an equatorial herbivore. Its huge bluffing teeth are not even used to gnaw down its primary food plants (tall woody stalks locally called 'rocket grass').|Personal notes of Wilek Nereus|<ref name="TTaBS" />}}
Usean II was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] that occupied the second [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="TTaBS" /> in the [[Usean system/Legends|Usean system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]].<ref name="EAOC Usean" /> Its [[Plant/Legends|flora]] included the plant the local inhabitants referred to as [[rocket grass]], and the world's equatorial zone was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[lrashtash]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]] that had a set of incisor-like [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] to frighten away predators.<ref name="TTaBS" />

==History==
{{Quote|For my own entertainment and others' enjoyment, I invented a sport species &mdash; the Useani camnzin, a mountain dweller that wiped out several herbivorous species in the green valleys of Usean II's equatorial zone.|Personal notes of Wilek Nereus|<ref name="TTaBS" />}}
[[File:LrashtashTeeth-TTaBS.png|thumb|right|180px|Wilek Nereus once collected a set of teeth belonging to the Usean II herbivore lrashtash.]]
At some point before his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Wilek Nereus]], who eventually became the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of<ref name="TTaBS" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC Bakura">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Bakura system/Legends|Bakura system]]</ref> planet [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], was stationed on Usean II. There, Nereus obtained a set of lrashtash teeth to add to his dental [[Collector/Legends|collection]]. As soon as he was transferred to the [[Berea system/Legends|Berea system]],<ref name="TTaBS" /> in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> visitors began to ask Nereus about the origin of the teeth.<ref name="TTaBS" />

For his own entertainment&mdash;as well as that of the inquirers&mdash;Nereus invented the creature "[[Useani camnzin]]." According to the collector, the large pseudo-incisors belonged to the camnzin, which supposedly was a predator inhabiting Usean II's [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Nereus further claimed that the Useani camnzin was responsible for eliminating several of the herbivore species living in the [[Color/Legends|green]] valleys of that world's equatorial regions. Later, Nereus included a mention of Usean II in an entry of his personal notes dedicated to the lrashtash.<ref name="TTaBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Usean II was first mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[1996]] sourcebook published for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TTaBS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Usean system, and therefore Usean II, in grid square I-18.<ref name="TEA" />
